content:
alice_pm: Quick sync — we need to finalize gating and who owns rollforward for the upcoming feature-window. TL;DR: customer opt-ins + region staging + clear fallback bindings.
ben_eng_lead: +1. propose 3 gates: 1) infra readiness, 2) telemetry thresholds, 3) customer opt-in list. who volunteers for each?
carmen_sre: I can own infra readiness and the kill-switch wiring. will add runbook snippets to the console.
dave_se: I'll take customer opt-ins and the mapping to dedicated routes. need a short doc for account-level exemptions.
ellen_qa: QA will own the telemetry thresholds. we need signal names and expected ranges.
frank_cs: I can collate opt-ins from the top 5 enterprise customers and validate their concerns. will push a list tomorrow.
alice_pm: Nice. For rollout policy: propose phased ramp: 0.5% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100% over configurable windows, with mandatory hold at each stage for 6h telemetry review.
ben_eng_lead: Sounds good. also require automated fallback binding: if p50 latency > 300ms OR user-facing error rate > 0.5% over 10m, auto-fallback to previous model variant.
carmen_sre: Agree, but let's be conservative on error rate signal. suggest p95 latency > 750ms OR 5xx rate > 0.3%.
ellen_qa: We should also include quality regression checks — e.g., perplexity/score on hooded eval set must not degrade by >2% during ramp.
dave_se: For A/B experiments, do we run a split for 20% of a stable cohort? we need sample size calc. rough numbers: for a 1% effect detect at 80% power, we'll need ~50k impressions per arm.
alice_pm: We'll only run A/B for a small test; majority will be rollforward gating. A/B will be opt-in feature flag named `feat:search-ux.experimental_ab_v1`.
frank_cs: Naming convention: customers want clear opt-out path. please ensure flag is tenant-scoped: `tenant.feature.search_v2` and not org-wide.
ben_eng_lead: Implementation note: flag config should include `ramp_percent`, `region_whitelist`, `force_variant`, `rollback_marker`. Example YAML:
```
flag: tenant.feature.search_v2
ramp_percent: 5
region_whitelist: [eu-west-1, us-east-1]
force_variant: null
rollback_marker: false
```
ellen_qa: I'll wire the telemetry to these metric names: `search.latency.p50`, `search.latency.p95`, `search.errors.5xx`, `search.quality.eval_score.delta`.
carmen_sre: Launch-bot will handle automated fallback; need the exact thresholds encoded in the flag metadata and in the autoscaler rules.
launch-bot: Deploy check queued — will verify flag metadata presence and alert if any field missing.
dave_se: Clarify responsibilities during rollforward: eng leads will monitor infra + perf, SRE monitors platform health + triggers fallback, PM owns customer comms and go/no-go.
alice_pm: Add product acceptance: customer-facing doc + public-facing release notes + internal playbook must be ready before stage 2.
frank_cs: For customers with strict SLAs, we will provide an explicit rollback ETA and a dedicated contact. add a customer-specific decoupling plan.en_eng_lead: On fallback semantics: prefer graceful degrade (route to smaller model variant) rather than full cutoff where possible. fallback chain:
1) variant-reduce-size
2) region-fallback
3) full-disable (last resort)
ellen_qa: QA: create smoke checklist for each stage and add automated synthetic tests that run every 10m against a canary tenant.
dave_se: For staged regions: start with non-production cohorts in `us-west-2`, then EU, then APAC. make sure data residency flags are respected.
carmen_sre: I'll add a circuit-breaker metric: if backend GPU saturation > 85% for 5m, trigger `variant-reduce-size` and alert on-call.
alice_pm: Negotiation note: backlog scope — customers asked for configurable timeout per tenant. that's a scope add. decision: ship V1 with global timeout + tenant override in V1.1.
frank_cs: Customers ask for opt-out APIs. we'll expose an endpoint `POST /v1/tenants/:id/feature-opt` for CS-run overrides.
ben_eng_lead: Deployment windows: we must avoid peak traffic hours for the top 10 customers. propose start windows between 0100-0500 UTC.
ellen_qa: Also include a freeze period for code merges during stage gates: no infra changing PRs during gated 12h windows.
dave_se: Rollforward roles doc: I'll make a short one-pager and link in the rollout ticket. includes owners, slack handoff, paging list.
alice_pm: Great. Action items: ben - add flag schema + rollback knobs; carmen - runbook + bot hooks; ellen - telemetry dashboard + synthetic tests; dave - opt-in mapping + one-pager; frank - customer list + API plan.
frank_cs: I'll start outreach and flag customers who need pre-approval.
launch-bot: Reminder: create canary tenant and schedule synthetic job before any ramp. :robot_face:
alice_pm: Thanks team — can we reconvene tomorrow AM to sign off on the one-pager and thresholds? :calendar:
ben_eng_lead: Yup. will have schema draft by EOD.
ellen_qa: I'll post initial dashboards by morning.
carmen_sre: I'll stub runbook and add circuit-breaker rules.
frank_cs: Outreach started.
alice_pm: Perfect — closing this thread. will open PR for rollout ticket and ping here when ready. :thumbsup:
